bullets: • Enforce strict linting: no CSS outside style blocks, no duplicate rules, no mixed color formats.
• Remove deprecated webkit properties; use standard CSS equivalents only.
• Implement graceful empty data handling in feature progressions.
• Maintain comprehensive test coverage; aim for 9+ tests per item.
• Validate JSON structure before submission; reject malformed responses.
• Include complete file content for all new files referenced.
• Verify patch file references exist with corresponding diff content.
• Implement new files atomically within single patch submission.
